Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.item

Class Weapon

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item.Item
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item.Equipment
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item.Weapon
All Implemented Interfaces:
Attack, BuildModifier
Direct Known Subclasses:
MeleeWeapon, RangedWeapon
public abstract class Weapon extends Equipment implements Attack
The equipped weapon: the player's attack (GDD 1.3.1, 1.6). Its attack bonus and attack speed go into its holder's build (see modify(com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.stats.CharacterBuild)); it only hits targets within its range (Q37).

Pattern: Strategy. Each weapon is one Attack; the character calls it without knowing which weapon it is, and equipping another weapon swaps the strategy.

  • Constructor Details

    • Weapon

      protected Weapon(String id, String nameKey, String spriteId, Rarity rarity, int price, int attackBonus, float attackSpeed, float range)
      Creates a weapon.
      Parameters:
      id - the item's key in the data files
      nameKey - the translation key of its name
      spriteId - the picture the renderer draws for it
      rarity - its loot tier; never Rarity.CONSUMABLE
      price - its shop price in coins; 0 means free
      attackBonus - the flat bonus added to the holder's ATTACK when it builds; 0 or more
      attackSpeed - its base attack speed; it multiplies the holder's ATTACK_SPEED when it builds (GDD 1.6); above 0 and finite
      range - how far its hit reaches, in pixels; above 0 and finite
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if a text or the rarity is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if a text is blank, the price or the attack bonus is negative, the rarity is CONSUMABLE, or the attack speed or the range is not a finite number above 0
